draft.overall: The after-hours briefing covers the regular session that closed at 16:00 ET. NXL led the covered gainers, up 76 percent from the prior close, with fresh news found in our sources: Nexalin announced a 10-year exclusive distribution and local-manufacturing agreement for Brazil and South America. NAMM was up 35 percent, with first-half results and a business update found in our sources, and EJH was up 26 percent, with news of an AI service robot launch found in our sources. Fresh news was found in our sources for 6 of the 12 names the desk covers. The desk covers 12 names into the next session.

lines.text: Nexalin announced a definitive 10-year exclusive distribution and local-manufacturing agreement covering Brazil and South America, published at 08:30 ET on October 1, 2026. The desk reads it as a company-specific commercialization story; the sources found give no contract value, minimum purchases or expected revenue, and do not say what conditions must be met before revenue is realized.

No fresh catalyst: only older news was found in our sources, a September 3, 2026 company announcement of a retail launch of Perfecta plant-based meat in the Northeastern U.S., its first U.S. store-shelf placement. No sales, store-count or contract-value figure was disclosed. Since the previous checkpoint it is down 18.1% and lost $0.83 support.

Airship AI announced $29.0M of firm-fixed-price awards from an agency within the U.S. Department of Homeland Security, published at 09:00 ET on October 1, 2026. The desk reads it as a company-specific revenue opportunity with a stated contract value; the performance period, delivery schedule and revenue-recognition timing are not on file.

The company's Form S-3 shelf registration covering up to $50.0 million of stock, preferred stock and warrants became effective on September 30, 2026. That is financing capacity only; no takedown, offering or sale is documented, and the evidence does not show the shelf caused the move.
Research is not on file for this name at this checkpoint.

No fresh catalyst: only older news was found in our sources, the company's disclosed completed sale of Altruis Benefit Consulting for $8 million in cash plus an earnout of up to $1 million (8-K at 17:51 ET on September 29, 2026). The desk reads it as cash that may improve liquidity; the earnout amount and probability are unknown.

E-Home announced the launch of a dedicated AI service robot for China's household-services market at 07:15 ET on October 1, 2026. It is paired with a September 29 private-placement agreement for 71.8 million shares at $0.60, stated gross proceeds $43.08 million; the desk sees that as prospective supply, and the evidence does not confirm the placement has closed.
